method: Neutral reimport. Independent welded head-region islands, min extent 3 mm, max extent >=55 mm. Exclude eye-weighted components, tails, small decals, exact contacts and grazing angles <5.7 degrees. For true triangle crossings, sample every 3 mm or less. Visible if the first two-sided scene ray is within 1 mm. Materials and alpha clipping are ignored. Internal seams are retained separately. Non-neighbour triangle crossings inside each selected island are reported separately and in the total. Shared-vertex neighbours, very small facial components and alpha visibility are outside this measure.
